desc: Derive and verify the exact layered threshold-variable min-cut formulation, including source/sink conventions, implication arcs, terminal constraints, multiedge costs, and correctness proof.
Prove that “at most K” in feasibility is equivalent to “exactly K” by adding arbitrary extra selected edges, which cannot decrease shortest-path distances.
Establish bounds and binary search strategy over distances 0 through K.
Ensure the Python Dinic implementation is recursion-depth safe for up to 3000 layered nodes.
Validate the formulation and implementation against the public samples, including parallel direct edges and zero-answer cases.
